notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
v0.1.3.2 Notes

NPCs will no longer always be present. Still currently just the one available, but now they have a random chance of appearing at a random point during the game.
Leaderboard should be able to show more than 15 scores now.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
v0.1.3.1 Notes

Added new animations for Dashing Ability
Removed millisecond timer.
Added an NPC to the Shop. Currently, it's the only NPC and will always be there. Though in future updates, the NPC will randomly show up, and there are more characters planned.
Added a temporary graphic to show the player how to interact with shop item boxes.
Minor bug fixes
